title: Add wait_for_tasks so a conductor can block on results
done_when: wait_for_tasks blocks on the given task ids until each reaches a terminal status or a timeout fires, returns the get_task_result payload, and tests prove both paths: early return on completion, and bounded return on a hung pane. NOTE: unmerged work exists on feat/wait-and-nudge (fb1f041); review it before writing new. Blocked on e18r66, or a wait will hang forever on a dead pane's task.
